fact: FIRS says TaxPro-Max enables registration, filing and payment of taxes.
FIRS says TaxPro-Max enables payment of taxes and that taxpayers cannot pay without the Document Identity Number it generates.
FIRS says that from 7 June 2021 TaxPro-Max is the channel for filing all Naira-denominated tax returns, with manual returns uploaded by FIRS staff.
The article states TaxPro Max, the FIRS digital tax administration platform, enables taxpayer registration and filing of returns in a fully automated environment.
FIRS directed that all tax payments must originate from assessments on TaxPro Max, which the article says handles payment processing.
